4713:
** στάμν-ος**, ὁ,
also ἡ {{NT+5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hermippus Comicus 82.7, 3rd c.BC: Eratosthenes Epicus cited in 2nd c.AD: Athenaeus Epigrammaticus 11.499e, NT.Heb.9.4}}:— **earthen jar** or **bottle for racking off wine** (compare κατασταμνίζω), {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Aristophanes Comicus “Plutus” 545, “fragment” 531, 5th c.BC: Hermippus Comicus [same place], 4th c.BC: Demosthenes Orator 35.32}}: generally, **jar**, {{LXX+5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “ἐπιδημίαι” 7.89; σ. μέλιτος LXX.1Ki.12.24h}}; σ. χρυσῆ ἔχουσα τὸ μάννα {{NT|[same place=NT.Heb.9.4]}}; used to keep money in, {{Refs 3rd c.BC+|“IG” 11(2).287 A 76 (Delos, 3rd c.BC), “PTeb.” 46.35 (2nd c.BC)}}; as a ballot-box, {{Refs 4th c.BC+|“Jahresh.” 23 “Beibl.” 75 (Pygela, 4th-3rd c.BC)}}; as a measure, τοῦ ἐλαίου {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|“SIG” 900.27 (Panamara, 4th c.AD): ἀμφορέα· τὸν δίωτον στάμνον, Ἀττικῶς, στάμνον, Ἑλληνικῶς, 2nd c.AD: Moeris Grammaticus p.44 P.}}

4739:
** στήκω**,
late _present_ formed from ἕστηκα (_perfect_ of ἵστημι), **stand**, {{LXX+NT|LXX.3Ki.8.11, NT.Rom.14.4, NT.1Cor.16.13, “Hippiatrica” 69; _imperative_ στῆκε “PMag.Par.” 1.923}}; _participle_, παρὼν καὶ στήγων (sic) {{Refs 4th c.AD+|“PLips.” 40 ii 4 (4th-5th c.AD)}}; so **ἑστήκω**, {{Refs 3rd c.BC+|3rd c.BC: Posidippus Comicus cited in 2nd c.AD: Athenaeus Epigrammaticus 10.412e}}.
4758:
** στρᾰτο-λογέω**,
(λέγω (B)) **levy an army, enlist soldiers**, {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Dionysius Halicarnassensis 11.24, 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Antiquitates Judaicae” 5.1.28, +others}}:—_passive_, ἐκ συμμάχων στρατολογηθέντων {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Diodorus Siculus Historicus 12.67, compare 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Caesar” 35.}}
4759:
** στρᾰτοπεδ-άρχης**, ου, ὁ,
**military commander**, {{Refs 1st c.BC+|“BGU” 1822.13 (1st c.BC, probably), 1st c.BC: Dionysius Halicarnassensis 10.36, 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Bellum Judaicum” 6.4.3, Mitteis “Chr.” 87.5 (2nd c.AD), 5th c.AD: Proclus Philosophus “Par. Ptol.” 245}}; = **praefectus castrorum**, {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|“CIL” 3.13648, 141875 (from Pontus), 2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Hist.Conscr.” 22, “Corpus Glossariorum Latinorum”}}
4763:
** στρηνιάω**,
**run riot, wax wanton**, {{NT+4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Antiphanes Comicus 82, 4th c.BC(?): Sophilus Comicus 6, 4th-3rd c.BC: Diphilus Comicus 132, 3rd c.BC: Lycophron Tragicus “Fragmenta Tragica - TGF” 1.2, NT.Rev.18.7, 9, “PMeyer” 20.23 (3rd c.AD)}};= **gerrio, gestio,** {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|“Corpus Glossariorum Latinorum”; compare 2nd c.AD: Phrynichus Atticista 357.}}
4767:
** στῠγ-ητός**, όν,
**hated, abominated, hateful**, Ἥρᾳ σ. {{NT+4th c.BC+|4th-5th c.BC: Aeschylus Tragicus “Prometheus Vinctus” 592: _absolutely_, 1st c.AD: Philo Judaeus 2.202, NT.Tit.3.3, “POxy.” 433.28; σ. ἔρως 3rd c.AD: Heliodorus Scriptor Eroticus 5.29.}}
4768:
** στυγν-άζω**,
(στυγνός) **to have a gloomy, lowering look**, ἐπὶ τῷ λόγῳ {{NT+7th c.AD+|NT.Mark.10.22: _absolutely_, “PMag.Leid.W.” 5.5, 7th c.AD: Stephanus Medicus “in Hp.” 2.514D.}}; of threatening weather, {{NT|NT.Matt.16.3.}}
4770:
** στωϊκ-ός**, ή, όν,
(στοά) **of a colonnade** or **porch**: hence, {{Refs 1st c.BC+|“Stoic” (because Zeno taught in the στοὰ Ποικίλη), οἱ τῆς Σ. αἱρέσεως ἡγεμόνες 1st c.BC: Dionysius Halicarnassensis “de Compositione Verborum” 2, compare 1st c.BC-1st c.AD: Strabo Geographus 13.1.57, 14.6.3}}; ἡ Σ. {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Philodemus Gadarensis Epigrammaticus “Rh.” 2.227S., 3rd c.AD(?): Diogenes Laertius 6.14}}; οἱ Σ. the {{NT+1st c.BC+|“Stoics”, 1st c.BC: Philodemus Gadarensis Epigrammaticus “Rh.” 2.296S., compare “IG” 3.1359, 3rd c.AD(?): Diogenes Laertius 7.5; οἱ Σ. φιλόσοφοι NT.Act.17.18}}. (**Στοϊκός** in {{Refs|“Anthologia Graeca” 9.496 (from Athenaeus).)}}
4781:
** συγ-κάμπτω**,
**bend**, τὸ σκέλος {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “περὶ ἄρθρων ἐμβολῆς” 14, 5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Phaedo” 60b; συγκάμψας τὰν χῆρα καθ᾽ ἕνα ἐκτείνειν τῶν δακτύλων “IG” 42(1).121.28 (Epid., 4th c.BC)}}; of legs, arms, spine, etc., {{LXX|Diocl.fragment 141; τὸν νῶτόν τινων LXX.Psa.68(69).24}}: _intransitive_, **bend down**,{{LXX|LXX.4Ki.4.35:—}}_passive_, opposed to ἐκτείνεσθαι, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Xenophon Historicus “de Equitandi ratione” 12.5; συγκεκαμμένῳ τῷ σκέλει, of a person mounting a horse, [prev. work] 7.2}}; συγκεκαμμένος τοῖς δακτύλοις with the fingers **doubled up.** {{Refs 3rd c.AD+|3rd c.AD(?): Diogenes Laertius 6.29}}; especially of the action of sitting down, συγκαμφθεὶς κάθημαι {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Phaedo” 98d, compare 5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “κατ᾽ ἰητρεῖον” 9, 4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “Problemata” 885b34}}; of the foetus in the womb, {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|[prev. author] “HA” 586b1, 2nd c.AD: Soranus Medicus 2.60}}; of the chest in phthisis, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “περὶ τόπων τῶν κατὰ ἄνθρωπον” 14}}; of animals **lying down with their knees bent under them**, σ. ἡ βοῦς {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “Historia Animalium” 575a14}}:—in _passive_ also, **bend together with**, ἐπιφανείας -εσθαι τοῖς σώμασιν {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.63c.}}
4791:
** συγκοινων-ός**, όν,
**partaking jointly of**, τῆς ῥίζης {{NT+7th c.AD+|NT.Rom.11.17, cf. NT.1Cor.9.23; ἐν τῇ θλίψει NT.Rev.1.9; τῆς βασιλείας μου 7th c.AD: Stephanus Medicus “in Hp.” 1.76D.}}: _substantive_, **partner,** {{Refs 6th c.AD+|PMasp. 158.11 (6th c.AD).}}
4795:
** συγκῠρ-ία**, ἡ,
= {συγκύρησις}, τὰ ἀπὸ συγκυρίης λυπήματα γνώμης **chance** annoyances, {{NT+5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “περὶ χυμῶν” 9; διὰ συγκυρίην [prev. author] “VM” 10; κατὰ συγκυρίαν NT.Luke.10.31, 12th c.AD: Eustathius Episcopus Thessalonicensis 376.12.}}
